label: architect • save notes with a tool step
query: Build a workflow whose input is a title and some notes, and that saves the notes as a Markdown file named after the title in the working folder. Use a tool step to write the file, with no model step. Test it with a short note, then offer to save it.
notes: Tool-only workflow. Pins that the Architect finds `file_write` with `workflow_draft` action `tools`, builds a `tool` node whose arguments bind the input, and that the test run writes the file in the run folder.
